title: Servo weekly pulse - prep & follow-ups
content:
Context / purpose:
- Quick prep doc for Monday's Servo pulse (30m). Mix of team-wide updates and 1:1 follow-ups.
- Goal: surface regressions/risks, align on short action queue, unblock rollouts. Keep it lightweight.

Pre-read (send Friday):
- Latency heatmap (last 72h) — attach console view link
- Canary rollout status for q3-quantized-gptj — current throughput vs baseline
- Two recent incidents: 2026-03-08 KV-cache pressure; 2026-03-09 streaming fallback spike

Agenda (30m total):
1) Quick pulse (5m) — each person: 1 line status (green/amber/red) + one ask
2) Incidents summary (5m) — root cause hypotheses + immediate mitigations accepted?
3) Canary & rollouts (7m) — q3-quantized-gptj performance gaps; fallback policy timing
4) Console follow-ups (6m) — dashboard gaps, tracing hooks request, per-route cost breakout
5) Actions & owners (5m) — assign and timebox

Notes / talking points to hit:
- KV cache pressure: still unclear whether pressure correlates with a small cohort of long-lived chat sessions. Hypothesis: some clients pin a very long conversation and we never trim their prefix cache properly. Need sampling + TTL policy review.
- Streaming fallback spike: mid-week we saw sudden increase in full-response fallbacks to non-stream path; suspect packet loss to the new eu-west1 edge. Ask SRE: any egress changes?
- Quantized model throughput: end-to-end latency on 2048 token traces still 18% worse on q3-quantized. Kernel fallback to fp16 on certain attention patterns — need kernel selection logging.
- Console request: add 'retries by route' and 'cache hit ratio by model+route' panels. Also a lightweight alert when cost per 1k tokens deviates >20% week-over-week.

1:1 follow-ups (pull from last week):
- Evan: demo of new batching heuristic (deferred until performance test completes). Check whether batch sizing respects the per-tenant SLO.
- Maya: rollout checklist for private deployments — still waiting on legal sign-off for the new KMS flow.
- Samir: run the streaming regression harness against canaries and record traces with full network metadata.

Parking lot / unresolved questions:
- Do we want a short-term TTL (e.g., 4h) for KV cache entries for chat sessions that exceed 10k tokens? Pros/cons to discuss after data sampling.
- How tight should the console alerts be to avoid paging DRI for trivial cost blips?

Action items (to capture in the meeting and add to JIRA):
- Evan - add kernel-selection logging for quantized model paths; sample 10k requests across 24h; due 2026-03-17.
- Samir - run streaming harness on canaries, attach traces to JIRA-OPS-332; due 2026-03-14.
- Maya - follow up with Legal on KMS private-deploy checklist; update rollout doc; due 2026-03-16.
- Nora (me) - create dashboard mock for 'cache hit ratio by model+route' and share with console PM; due 2026-03-13 (morning).
- SRE (ask: Priya) - confirm any edge egress changes in eu-west1 between 2026-03-08 and 2026-03-09; reply in thread; due 2026-03-13 EOD.

Quick wins to mention in sync:
- Auto-batching micro-optim: single-token requests now avoid a full model load for cached prefix-only traffic (rollout completed Friday, observed ~6% cost reduction for small chat flows).
- New per-tenant quota telemetry landed in dev-console; still needs UI exposure.

Tone & delivery notes (for me):
- Keep the sync to 30m. Use the first 5 min as rapid voice-check; if deep technical discussion needed, spin off a focused 30–60m follow-up with the right folks.
- Where possible, convert asks into explicit JIRA tickets during the meeting. Avoid ambiguous "I'll look into it" notes.

Draft messages to send before the meeting:
- To team (short): "Quick pre-read attached: latency heatmap + canary status. Please flag any blockers you want on the agenda by EOD Friday."
- To SRE (private): "Priya — can you confirm eu-west1 egress changes for 2026-03-08/09? saw streaming fallback spike; attaching traces."

Today's micro-checklist (my prep):
- Attach 72h latency heatmap to the calendar invite.
- Confirm Evan has sample log access for kernel-selection.
- Sketch mock dashboard and attach PNG to pre-read.
- Add placeholder JIRA tickets for the five action items above so we can assign during the sync.

Random scratch notes (keep here for later):
- If we do TTL experiment on KV cache, need to ensure rollback plan to avoid mass cache misses causing warmup thundering herd. Could gate by tenant fraction.
- Consider adding a lightweight 'session-length' label to traces to correlate long-lived chats with cache pressure.

End of doc.
